تتنازعون (form VI)
# تَتَنَازَعُونَ (tatanāzaʕūna) /ta.ta.naː.za.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
# تُتَنَازَعُونَ (tutanāzaʕūna) /tu.ta.naː.za.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَنَازَعَ (tanāzaʕa)
